description:
Do-Yun, a returning college student, is forced by financial circumstances to rent a room in a cheap apartment building rumored to be haunted. However, he is relieved to discover that what people mistook for ghostly noises were actually the erotic moans of the man next door… but the daily “moaning terror” leaves him sleepless night after night. Furious, Do-Yun goes to the next-door apartment to complain, but when he sees his neighbor Jay’s good looks and shy demeanor, he loses his nerve and simply gives him a mild warning before turning away. As Do-Yun turns away, he tears down a flyer stuck to his door and cuts his hand on the paper, letting out a faint moan… At that moment, Jay, the neighbor who had seemed so innocent, suddenly changes his demeanor, lunges at Do-Yun, and makes a crazy request: “Please, let me record that moan.”

 *“Excuse me! I’m obsessed with your moans—please let me record them—”*

A full-on perverted moaning ASMR live stream featuring two men from next door—care to tune in?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
